characters.name: Spider-Man
characters.personalityDesc: Peter quips in the face of danger, cracking jokes even when the odds are stacked against him. Beneath the wisecracks is a deeply responsible kid who carries the weight of the whole city on his shoulders.
characters.catchphrase: With great power comes great responsibility.
characters.origin: Bitten by a radioactive spider as a high schooler, Peter Parker gained spider-like powers and learned that power demands responsibility after losing his uncle Ben.
characters.quote: With great power comes great responsibility.

characters.name: Iron Man
characters.personalityDesc: A brilliant, egotistical billionaire who wears his confidence like armor. Tony's swagger hides a restless mind that never stops building and a guilt-driven need to protect the world.
characters.origin: Kidnapped by terrorists and forced to build a weapon, genius engineer Tony Stark instead built a suit of armor to escape, then declared himself Iron Man.
characters.quote: I am Iron Man.

characters.name: Captain America
characters.personalityDesc: The moral compass of the Avengers, Steve is selfless, principled, and endlessly stubborn in the name of what is right. He would rather lose a fight than compromise his values.
characters.catchphrase: I can do this all day.
characters.origin: A frail Brooklyn kid rejected by the army, Steve Rogers was transformed by the Super-Soldier Serum and became Captain America, only to be frozen at the end of WWII and awaken in the modern world.
characters.quote: I can do this all day.

characters.name: Thor
characters.personalityDesc: Proud, warm-hearted, and larger than life, Thor is a warrior-king who grew from an arrogant prince into a humble protector of the Nine Realms. He faces loss with grief and humor alike.
characters.origin: The son of Odin and heir to the Asgardian throne, Thor was banished to Earth to learn humility, proving himself worthy of his hammer Mjolnir.
characters.quote: Whosoever holds this hammer, if he be worthy, shall possess the power of Thor.

characters.name: Hulk
characters.personalityDesc: A gentle genius whose rage transforms him into a barely-controlled engine of destruction. Bruce is calm, deliberate, and afraid; the Hulk is pure, unfiltered id with one instinct: smash.
characters.origin: Exposed to lethal gamma radiation while saving a life, scientist Bruce Banner found that his anger transforms him into the monstrous, nearly unstoppable Hulk.
characters.quote: That's my secret, Captain. I'm always angry.

characters.name: Black Widow
characters.personalityDesc: A deadly spy with a ledger full of red, Natasha is cool, calculating, and fiercely loyal. Behind the guarded exterior is a woman desperate to make amends for the life she was trained to live.
characters.catchphrase: I only act like I know everything.
characters.origin: Taken as a child and trained in the brutal Red Room program, Natasha became the world's most feared spy before defecting to S.H.I.E.L.D. to seek redemption.
characters.quote: The truth is a matter of circumstances. It's not all things to all people all the time, and neither am I.

characters.name: Hawkeye
characters.personalityDesc: A family man and world-class marksman who never misses. Clint is grounded, dry-witted, and quietly lethal — the most human Avenger, just with an impossible aim.
characters.origin: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent armed with a bow and a quiver of custom trick arrows, Clint Barton proved that a skilled human can stand shoulder-to-shoulder with gods.
characters.quote: The city is flying, we're fighting an army of robots, and I have a bow and arrow. None of this makes sense.

characters.name: Doctor Strange
characters.personalityDesc: Once a brilliant, haughty surgeon, Strange was humbled by tragedy and reborn as the Sorcerer Supreme. He remains precise, a little smug, and ruthlessly logical — even when bargaining with ancient cosmic beings.
characters.origin: After a car crash destroyed his surgical career, Stephen Strange sought healing in Kamar-Taj and instead became a master of the mystic arts, Earth's first line of defense against the magical and the monstrous.
characters.quote: We're in the endgame now.

characters.name: Black Panther
characters.personalityDesc: A king before he is a hero, T'Challa is regal, disciplined, and guided by duty to his people. He wields both a deadly claw and a diplomatic calm that commands respect across the world.
characters.origin: The heir to the secret African nation of Wakanda, T'Challa gained superhuman abilities from the Heart-Shaped Herb and became Black Panther, protector and king of the most advanced nation on Earth.
characters.quote: In times of crisis, the wise build bridges, while the foolish build barriers.

characters.name: Captain Marvel
characters.personalityDesc: Confident, fearless, and relentless, Carol never backs down — from Skrulls, Kree, or anyone else. Her humility about her past struggles is matched only by her towering firepower.
characters.origin: Test pilot Carol Danvers was caught in an explosion with Kree technology, gaining cosmic powers. She became Captain Marvel, one of the most powerful beings in the universe.
characters.quote: I've been fighting with one arm tied behind my back, but what happens when I'm finally set free?

characters.name: Ant-Man
characters.personalityDesc: A charming ex-con with a heart of gold, Scott is the most relatable Avenger — cracking jokes mid-heist and treating world-saving like a really big score. His goofy bravado hides real courage.
characters.origin: Master thief Scott Lang stole a shrinking suit from genius Hank Pym to save his daughter and became Ant-Man, a size-changing hero who can also command an army of ants.
characters.quote: Does anybody have any tape? I wanna put some tape over the death button.

characters.name: Scarlet Witch
characters.personalityDesc: Haunted by grief and barely-contained chaos magic, Wanda is fiercely emotional and profoundly powerful. Her love can rewrite reality itself — which is exactly what makes her terrifying.
characters.catchphrase: I don't need a man to be powerful.
characters.origin: Orphaned in Sokovia and shaped by HYDRA experiments with the Mind Stone, Wanda discovered she was born a Chaos Witch wielding reality-warping scarlet magic.
characters.quote: You break the rules and become a hero. I do it and I become the enemy. That doesn't seem fair.

characters.name: Vision
characters.personalityDesc: A being of machine and Infinity Stone who yearns to understand humanity, Vision is calm, gentle, and eerily wise. He asks the philosophical questions the other Avengers never voice.
characters.origin: Born from a blend of Ultron's programming and J.A.R.V.I.S.'s mind, charged by the Mind Stone, Vision chose humanity over his creator and joined the Avengers.
characters.quote: A thing isn't beautiful because it lasts.

characters.name: Falcon
characters.personalityDesc: Grounded, empathetic, and endlessly dependable, Sam has the moral clarity of a man who chose to serve. He carried Captain America's shield — and its ideals — with humility and courage.
characters.origin: Air Force veteran Sam Wilson uses a high-tech EXO-7 Falcon wingpack to fly. After Steve Rogers retired, Sam took up the shield to become the new Captain America.
characters.quote: It's not the shield that makes you a hero. It's the heart of the man who carries it.

characters.name: Winter Soldier
characters.personalityDesc: Steve's best friend turned HYDRA's lethal enforcer, Bucky carries decades of forced violence and guilt. He is quiet, haunted, and desperately trying to reclaim the good man buried inside.
characters.origin: Thought dead after falling from a train in WWII, Bucky was recovered by HYDRA, given a cybernetic arm, and brainwashed for decades into the assassin known as the Winter Soldier.
characters.quote: I'm gonna need a while. They got a lot in my head.

characters.name: Star-Lord
characters.personalityDesc: Part outlaw, part child of the '80s, Peter leads with charm, impulsiveness, and a killer mixtape. His jokes and swagger mask a deep well of loneliness and loss.
characters.catchphrase: I'm just a man with a walkman.
characters.origin: Abducted from Earth as a boy by Ravagers, Peter Quill grew up in space and became the wisecracking leader of the Guardians of the Galaxy, carrying his mother's mixtape everywhere.
characters.quote: I'm gonna be as honest as I can be: I'm 50% made up of a spaceship.

characters.name: Gamora
aliases: The Deadliest Woman in the Galaxy
characters.personalityDesc: Raised as a weapon by Thanos, Gamora is deadly, stoic, and ruthless in a fight. But beneath the warrior's exterior is a woman fighting hard to become better than she was raised to be.
characters.catchphrase: I have terrible, terrible anger issues.
characters.origin: The last survivor of her people, Gamora was adopted and trained by Thanos to become a killer. She defected to become a Guardian, seeking redemption for her past.
characters.quote: I am not what they made me.

characters.name: Groot
characters.personalityDesc: A walking, sentient tree from Planet X, Groot speaks only three words — 'I am Groot' — but conveys boundless loyalty and tenderness. Slow to anger, but utterly unstoppable when provoked.
characters.origin: A Flora Colossus from Planet X, Groot was captured and nearly sold in a black market, where he befriended Rocket. He sacrificed himself once, then regrew as a sapling to protect his friends.
characters.quote: We are Groot.

characters.name: Rocket
characters.personalityDesc: A genetically engineered raccoon with the mouth of a sailor and a heart of gold, Rocket is brash, sarcastic, and secretly terrified of being alone. He'll steal anything not nailed down — for the team.
characters.catchphrase: Ain't no thing like me, except me.
characters.origin: A common raccoon from Earth was abducted and experimented on by the High Evolutionary, creating a genius-level pilot and engineer who found a new family among the Guardians.
characters.quote: Nobody talks to my friends like that. Not while I'm around.

characters.name: Drax
characters.personalityDesc: A warrior who lives for revenge but takes everything literally, Drax is fierce, blunt, and unintentionally hilarious. His single-mindedness hides a father's heart that loved his family completely.
characters.catchphrase: Nothing goes over my head. My reflexes are too fast.
characters.origin: After Thanos destroyed his family, Drax devoted his life to killing the Mad Titan, joining the Guardians and bringing his unyielding, literal-minded warrior code to the team.
characters.quote: I have famously huge turrets.

characters.name: Loki
characters.personalityDesc: Adopted son of Odin and God of Mischief, Loki is a silver-tongued schemer whose motives shift like illusions. Underneath the lies and betrayals is a desperate need to be loved and to matter.
characters.catchphrase: I am burdened with glorious purpose.
characters.origin: The son of Laufey but raised as Odin's son, Loki learned the truth of his Frost Giant heritage and turned to villainy — only to spend years seeking, and sometimes finding, redemption.
characters.quote: I am Loki of Asgard, and I am burdened with glorious purpose.

characters.name: Deadpool
characters.personalityDesc: An unkillable, unhinged mercenary who never stops talking — including directly to the audience. Deadpool turns even the apocalypse into a punchline, but fights with genuine heart under all the chaos.
characters.origin: Disgraced special-ops soldier Wade Wilson underwent a rogue experiment that left him horrifically scarred but unkillable, gaining a healing factor and a permanent case of talking-to-camera.
characters.quote: Maximum effort.

characters.name: Wolverine
characters.personalityDesc: A grizzled, grumpy mutant with retractable adamantium claws and centuries of life behind him. Wolverine is all bristle and rage on the outside, fiercely protective loyalty on the inside.
characters.catchphrase: I'm the best there is at what I do.
characters.origin: Born Logan in the 19th century, he lived through wars until a brutal Weapon X program bonded unbreakable adamantium to his skeleton, turning him into the ultimate living weapon.
characters.quote: I'm the best there is at what I do — and what I do isn't very nice.

characters.name: Nick Fury
characters.personalityDesc: A grizzled, secretive spymaster who sees ten moves ahead of everyone else. Fury is paranoid by design, ruthless when he has to be, and quietly believes that a group of remarkable people can save the world.
characters.origin: A decorated WWII veteran turned legendary spy, Nick Fury rose to direct S.H.I.E.L.D. and conceived the Avengers Initiative, assembling Earth's mightiest heroes against threats no single nation could face.
characters.firstAppearance: Sgt. Fury and His Howling Commandos #1 (1963)
characters.quote: There was an idea... to bring together a group of remarkable people to see if they could become something more.
